b.p: BetOnYou ("we", "us") operates an accountability platform where people stake money on personal goals, invite believers to back them, and unlock a pot when AI-verified proof shows they followed through. This policy applies to our website, apps, and related services.
By using BetOnYou you agree to the collection and use of information as described here.
We collect only what we need to run challenges and keep payouts honest:

li: Account details — name, email, and profile information you provide.
Challenge data — goals, stakes, deadlines, and the believers you invite.
Proof submissions — photos, videos, GPS routes, and activity data you upload as evidence.
Payment information — processed by our payment partners; we never store full card numbers.
Usage data — device, browser, and interaction data used to improve the product.

b.p: Your information is used to build and adapt your challenge plan, verify proof, move funds between you and your believers, send timely reminders, and keep the platform secure.
We do not sell your personal data. We do not use your proof submissions to train third-party models without your explicit consent.

Proof is the heart of BetOnYou, so we treat it carefully. Submissions are analyzed by our verification system to confirm they are real and recent, then stored only as long as needed to resolve the challenge and any disputes.
You control what your believers see. They receive the progress you choose to share — never your raw files or location history.

We share limited information with the believers on your challenge (your progress and milestones) and with service providers who help us operate — payment processors, cloud hosting, and analytics — under strict confidentiality.
We may disclose information if required by law or to protect the rights and safety of our users.

We keep your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. After you close your account, we delete or anonymize your data within a reasonable period, except where retention is required for legal or accounting reasons.
Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal data, and to object to certain processing.

li: Access and download your data from account settings.
Delete your account and associated data at any time.

b.p: We use encryption in transit and at rest, access controls, and regular reviews to protect your data. No system is perfectly secure, but we work hard to keep yours safe and notify you promptly of any incident that affects you.
We may update this policy as the product evolves. Material changes will be highlighted in-app or by email, and the "last updated" date above will always reflect the current version.
Questions about your privacy? Reach us at privacy@betonyou.com and we'll get back to you.

By creating an account or using BetOnYou, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you don't agree, please don't use the platform. If you're using BetOnYou on behalf of an organization, you represent that you're authorized to accept these terms for it.

BetOnYou is an accountability platform. You set a goal, stake your own money, and invite believers to add to a pot. When you submit proof and it's verified, the pot is released to you. If you don't follow through, the stake is handled as described in these terms.
BetOnYou is not a gambling, investment, or money-transmission service. The pot is an accountability mechanism tied to your own goals, not a wager on chance.

You must be at least 18 and able to form a binding contract. You're responsible for your account credentials and for all activity under your account. Keep your information accurate and your login secure.
When you start a challenge you define the goal, the proof required, the deadline, and your stake. Believers may add funds to your pot.

li: Stakes and contributions are held by our payment partners for the duration of the challenge.
On success, the pot is released to you.
If the goal isn't met, contributions are returned to believers and your stake is handled per the challenge's rules.

b.p: Milestones count only when supported by proof that our verification system confirms is real and recent. You agree not to submit falsified, edited, or misleading evidence. We may review proof manually in case of disputes.

Payouts are processed through our payment partners once a challenge resolves. Applicable fees are shown before you commit. Because stakes are an accountability mechanism, they're generally non-refundable except where required by law or where a challenge is cancelled before it begins.

Don't use BetOnYou to break the law, harm others, or game the verification system. We may suspend or remove challenges and accounts that abuse the platform, submit fraudulent proof, or harass other users.

BetOnYou is provided “as is.” We don't guarantee you'll reach your goals, and to the fullest extent permitted by law we're not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform.
You can close your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate access if you violate these terms. Active challenges will be resolved according to their rules where possible.

These terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which BetOnYou Inc. is established, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. Disputes will be resolved in the courts of that jurisdiction.
Questions about these terms? Reach us at legal@betonyou.com.

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They let a site remember your actions and preferences over time. We also use similar technologies like local storage and pixels, which we refer to collectively as “cookies” here.
We use cookies to keep you signed in, remember your preferences, secure your account, understand how the product is used, and improve your experience. We do not use cookies to sell your data.

li: Essential — required to sign in, keep challenges secure, and process payments. The site can't function without these.
Preferences — remember settings like theme and reduced-motion choices.
Analytics — help us understand usage so we can improve. Aggregated and privacy-respecting.

b.p: We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. Your proof and challenge data are never shared with ad networks.

Some features rely on trusted partners — for example, payment processing and analytics. These partners may set their own cookies to deliver their service. We choose partners who meet our privacy standards.

You can control cookies through your browser settings — blocking or deleting them at any time. Note that disabling essential cookies may break sign-in and payments. Where required, we'll also show an in-product consent banner for non-essential cookies.

Some browsers offer a “Do Not Track” signal. Because there's no consistent industry standard, we currently treat these signals in line with our minimal-tracking approach and do not use cross-site advertising cookies regardless.
We may update this policy as our use of cookies evolves. The “last updated” date above always reflects the current version, and material changes will be highlighted in-product.
Questions about cookies? Reach us at privacy@betonyou.com.
